propositions: Code review request provenance via --ref/--source flags must reach CodeReviewRequest and carry source and verified_at_sha fields
Snapshot-entry contract enforcement must be validated by CI rather than asserted by architecture decision record
LLM-Review votes must attach to the tree that was actually reviewed
Library read paths must not terminate the host process
Retired configuration files must honor the deprecation registry behavior field
Deprecated documentation must no longer direct agents to incorrect commands
